name: Coach screen shell: four panes, tabs, swipe, deep links
where: coach.html VIEWS/header (accent dot), coach.html swipeViews(), coach.html ?view= boot
evidence: drove it — ?view=check-in opens the Check-in pane, the Check-in tab carries a dot while today's quota is unmet, and a horizontal touch swipe moves between the four panes (verified in Chromium with synthesised touch events; the swipe is ignored over the segmented control, the composer, fields and the dot row).

name: Chat error rows, retry, and paywall hand-off
gap: The local half is built: a rate-limit reply renders its own card (limitCard) saying the hour's messages are used, when the window resets, that nothing was lost, and offering the Check-in pane instead — and it deliberately does NOT offer Try again, which cannot work until the window resets. What is missing is the server: a coach endpoint that can actually return 429 with a reset time, and a billing/subscription surface for the higher cap. There is no account, no billing and no plans screen anywhere in this build, so the card says that rather than linking to nothing; no LOCKED.paywall() was invented.
where: coach.html limitCard(), coach.html bubble() m.limit, dev preset 'Chat / rate limited'
evidence: drove it via the dev preset

name: Reply parsing — structured action markers
gap: The parser is built and driven: parseReply() reads the shipped app's own markers — ###PROGRAM_START/END###, ###RECIPE_START/END###, ###GOAL_START/END###, ###FOOD_START/END###, ###CARDIO_START/END###, ###INSTRUCTIONS_START/END###, ###REMEMBER###…###/REMEMBER### and ###SHOPPING_ADD###…###/SHOPPING_ADD### — strips them from the visible text, adapts each block to the shape LKCoachActions expects, and reports an unreadable block as a refusal rather than dropping it. window.__coachReply(rawString) drives the whole path end to end. What remains is the model: replyFor() answers from this page and can never emit a marker, so nothing reaches the parser in normal use. The chat says so in its own copy (chat-model-note) rather than implying the coach chose not to propose anything.
evidence: drove it — a reply carrying five markers parsed to five actions, the text came back clean, and a malformed JSON block rendered as 'the goal block in the reply was not readable'.

name: Action card — save a training split
evidence: drove it — the card lists every day and every lift with its set count and muscle, resolved and renamed by the catalogue; Approve wrote lk_splits (ids 111/211/701), the applied card survived a reload, and Undo removed it. From file:// the catalogue cannot be fetched, and the card refuses with the gate's own reason plus a sentence saying why.

name: Action card — save a recipe / add ingredients to shopping
evidence: drove it — every ingredient is listed with its own macros and the totals are recomputed from them (a reply claiming 9,999 kcal over ingredients summing to 1,260 shows 1,260, and the card says so). Approve wrote lk_recipes; the shopping half goes through the approval modal and wrote lk_shoppingList.

name: Action card — create a goal
evidence: drove it — name, kind, target in the reader's unit, start, date and notes all shown; Approve wrote lk_goals and Undo removed it. A target of 9,000 kg is refused by the gate and the card prints the reason.

name: Action card — log food
evidence: drove it — slot, quantity and the full macro line, with the card saying whether the figures came from the food table or were carried by the reply. Approve wrote today's entry into lk_fuelLog and recomputed the day's totals; Undo removed the meal and put the totals back.

name: Action card — log cardio (CoachCardioCard)
evidence: drove it — name, minutes and distance shown; Approve wrote a cardio row into lk_history and Undo removed it. 100,000 minutes is refused with 'minutes between 1 and 600'.

name: Action card — save coaching instructions from chat
evidence: drove it — the card shows the proposed instructions in full and quotes what they would replace. Approve wrote lk_coachInstructions and the Setup pane's textarea held the new text on the same visit, without a reload.

name: "SAVE ALL (N ACTIONS)"
evidence: drove it — a reply carrying a goal, a cardio session, a fact, a shopping list and one refused action offered SAVE ALL (3 ACTIONS): the count excludes the shopping list, which keeps its own approval step, and a line under the button says so. One Undo in the toast and an 'Undo all 3' button both reverted the lot.

name: Shopping-list approval modal
evidence: drove it — the sheet lists every item with its quantity, unit and category before anything is added, and only 'Add all N to the list' writes lk_shoppingList. SAVE ALL cannot bypass it.

name: Remembered-fact chip with Undo
evidence: drove it — the fact renders as a chip rather than a card, Remember it wrote lk_coachMemory (which the Setup pane reads), Undo removed it, and the seeded fact already on the pane is preserved rather than being overwritten by the first write from chat.

name: Setup pane — coaching style / persona
gap: All seven of the shipped app's personas are here with their own descriptions (direct, warm, technical, teacher, hype, athlete, physio), the two ids this rebuild invented are migrated onto the ones lk_coachStyle actually holds, and the card shows the exact tone sentence that would go into the system prompt. What is missing is the model: the replies in Chat are written on this page and read identically whichever persona is picked. The card says that at the point of use rather than letting the picker imply an effect it cannot have.
where: coach.html STYLES, normStyle(), setupBody() style block, setup-style-effect
evidence: drove it

name: Coach interview (six questions → AI-written instructions)
gap: The whole local half works: six questions, Back, a review step, stored answers, Escape, and a draft built clause by clause from the answers. The progress list no longer claims work the code does not do — 'Reading your last 8 weeks' is gone, because draftInstructions reads no session — and the preview now says in full that it was assembled on this phone from the six answers, that no model was asked, and that the coach will write these instead once its endpoint is connected. What remains is that endpoint.
evidence: drove it

name: Plan pane — this week, overall progress, phase timeline
evidence: drove it — overall is 40% elapsed time and 60% targets across every target in the plan, and the card prints the basis underneath (the seeded plan reads 78% at week 6 of 12 with 5 of 5 targets having a logged best). A session-dots row counts lifting sessions dated since Monday out of lk_history against the bound split's training days (1 of 3 on the seed) and says cardio is not in it; an unbound plan shows no row, because there is nothing to compare against.

name: Plan pane — phase/plan review prompt
evidence: drove it — in the last week of a phase the card names the phase, names the one after it and offers Review with the coach; past the plan's last week it says the block is done and how long ago. Either puts the question in the composer rather than sending it. It also fixed a crash: phaseAt returns nothing past the last week, and planBody read ph.name off it, so the Plan tab threw and rendered blank for any plan that had run out.

name: Daily check-in — the form
evidence: drove it — per-step words under every button (the shipped app's own scales), the question above each group, and hours slept, the five CHECKIN_TAGS and a note field all written into lk_feedback in the key's real shape. It also fixed a lie: soreness was labelled 'None to Heavy', so 5 meant wrecked, while the key, the seed and every piece of arithmetic that reads it treat 5 as fresh — a reader answering honestly wrote the opposite of what they meant.

name: Check-in — the local coach response ("payoff card")
evidence: drove it — under fourteen readings the card counts how many are left before a baseline exists; with a 25-day baseline and a low reading it named the item, quoted the reader's own 30-day mean and offered two courses with the choice left to them; 'Talk about this' put its question in the composer. The seven-day mood rule writes lk_coachMoodRaisedAt and stays quiet for a fortnight. The card says it was worked out on the phone and no model was asked.

name: Check-in — 14-day dot row and day inspector
evidence: drove it — fourteen dots, one a day, newest last, filled where a reading exists and not tappable where none does; tapping one opens that day with every reading in words and numbers, plus hours slept, tags and the note. No streak counter and no streak language.

name: Check-in — done-for-today state
evidence: drove it — lk_checkinPerDay is read here now: with it set to 2 the bar reads 'Saved. 1 of 2 for today', the form clears for the second reading, and the log holds two entries for the day. At the quota the button becomes Replace today. The Check-in tab carries a dot until the day's quota is met.

name: Beta admin — code management
gap: Cut, with the reason written into coach.html as a comment above the stage. A beta admin console is an operator's tool that shipped inside the consumer app because there was nowhere else to put it: every person who installs LOCKED would get a screen for managing other people's access codes. It also cannot be honest on one device — a code list read out of this phone's localStorage describes nobody — and the real version is a server with an operator login, not a tab of a training app. Nothing is stranded: lk_betaCodes is written by nothing in this build.
evidence: decided and recorded in source

name: Beta admin — activity / AI logs / feedback tabs
gap: Cut for the same reason, recorded in the same comment in coach.html. Activity and AI-usage logs are facts about a fleet of testers; read out of one phone they report on one person, which is exactly the class of unbackable claim this build keeps having to delete. AI usage is metered where the model is called, which is the server. lk_betaLog and lk_betaAILog are written by nothing in this build, so nothing is stranded.
evidence: decided and recorded in source
